 The Closer – NVDA Earnings, 200-Day Break, Salience – 11/18/26
 Nov 17, 2026 
 Log-in here if you’re a member with access to the Closer. 
 The S&P 500 fell below its 200-DMA intraday today, only the 19th instance of an intraday move below that moving average after spending six months above since 1982.
 New York Fed data showed its contacts view AI as the most salient risk of the past several years.
 Over the past month and change, growth has underperformed value by the widest degree in over a quarter century.
